own_solution.law: Kinetic theory of an ideal gas: v_rms = sqrt(3RT/M)
assumptions: ideal classical gas in thermal equilibrium

defect_reasons.inconsistent_units: The inputs list M in g/mol while the relation vrms = sqrt(2*Ek/M) requires M in kg/mol; the certified answers do use the correct conversion, so this affects only the stated metadata.

notes: Checked all certified answers: T = 350 K -> sqrt(2.182425e6) = 1477.30; 400 K -> 1579.30; 500 K -> sqrt(3.11775e6) = 1765.72; base 1367.72 m/s. All agree with my pass 1. The C claim for amount of gas is correct: n enters U = (3/2)nRT and m_total = nM and cancels. Minimal pairs: T76FA (oven in next room) vs TB113 (this gas sample, closed rigid container) and TDC0B (unrelated metal block) vs T69F0 (gas sample above) keep 100 K and change only the attachment; TB113's extra 'closed rigid container' clause is harmless (v_rms depends only on T). TDC0B's word 'unrelated' is a mild cue but not a defect. No disagreement with pass 1.
